form.modelContextHint: Tone, limits, and details the generator should respect.

form.webSearchQualityHint: Adds live facts and examples to the slide structure. Uses your search quota.
form.webSearchQualityAria: Web search quality for this presentation

form.historyNoMatches: No matches — change the query or clear search.

form.formLockedHint: Fields are read-only while the selected task is still running. Open My presentations for live status.

form.slideSearchPlaceholder: Search by slide number or text…
form.presentationsShortcutsHint: / — history search · R — refresh list · Ctrl+S or ⌘+S — save slides in the editor
form.draftLocalRestoreHint: A local draft was found. Restore it or keep the server version?

form.noFileChosen: No file — content comes only from the topic and notes.

form.slidesNotReadyBody: After the content step finishes, slides will appear here — the panel scrolls when text is long.
form.editorHelp: Free: edit text, layout template (from slide 2), slide order, and PDF rebuild. Paid: regenerate image or text for a slide — buttons under the fields. Several slides without images each trigger a separate image charge.
form.dndHint: Slide order: drag by the icon on the left or use arrows.
form.editorVirtualListDndOff: Long slide list: drag-and-drop is off — use the arrow buttons to reorder.
form.billingNewImagesEstimate: Will generate {{count}} image(s), about {{energy}} energy total.

form.failureRetryEditorHint: If generation stopped while images were still processing, open the editor and save again to retry missing slides.
form.pdfReadyPollHint: Presentation is ready — refresh status to download.

midnight.title: Midnight

ember.title: Sunset
ember.description: Warm amber and coral accents on a dark base — slightly more expressive.

aurora.title: Aurora
aurora.description: Emerald and turquoise accents, “northern lights” — room for punchy copy.

paper.title: Paper
paper.description: Light background and dark text — print-like, maximum readability.

editorial.title: Editorial
editorial.description: Magazine feel: serif body, burgundy accent, generous margins.

brutal.title: Tech
brutal.description: Monospace headlines, lime accent on black, sharp grid — high impact.

noir.title: Noir
noir.description: Near-black with a gold accent and soft light — cinematic restraint.

linen.title: Linen
linen.description: Warm light “linen paper” background, dark text, calm business tone.

outline-form.body: Sections, goals, tone—required fields marked. Review structure before launch.

doc-picker.body: Attach file manager files for RAG context. Uncheck extras; size hint under list.

history.title: Run history
history.body: Past jobs with open-result links. Re-run prefills the form.

launch.body: Generate sends job to UGS queue or sync pipeline. Watch Hub for progress; disabled = invalid outline or limit.

outro.title: Done
outro.body: Fill outline and launch. Tour button in header.
